title: Improved patient support
content: I have had great difficulty getting appointments as the current system does not suit a single parent or a person with adhd & autism. In the past, calling the reception has been fruitless & I have not felt like the reception staff cared. But even in september 2021 when I had covid I was helped & most importantly listened to with respect. My distress was evident & I was helped to get back onto my meds. Also the technician who saw me offered me a blood test which was very helpful & supportive.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
